'''Commissioner of the Coruscant Constabulary''' was the title of the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the later years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] control of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

After the New Republic captured Coruscant from the Empire in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] believed that former [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Fliry Vorru]] wanted the position. However, they quickly decided against it and Vorru also declined to accept the position.

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Commissioner of the Coruscant Constabulary was first mentioned in ''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''.
